items.title: Rank-restricted product is visible to an unauthorized viewer
items.expected_behavior: A viewer who does not satisfy the product rank cannot see the rank-restricted product.
items.minimum_reproduction_condition: Use the catalog seed as a guest and inspect the storefront product list.
items.required_observation: The rank-restricted product is visible in the guest storefront list.
items.evidence_expectation: The rank-restricted product is visible in the guest storefront list.
